Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL262 (Glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL262, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
